title: Rename website branding to “Meyouu”

requirements.text: Update the website’s user-facing branding name to “Meyouu” wherever the app name is displayed (including the browser tab title, header logo alt text, footer copyright line, and homepage hero/banner alt text and headline).
acceptanceCriteria: Header branding uses “Meyouu” (e.g., logo alt text updated from “Marketplace” to “Meyouu”).
Footer copyright line shows “Meyouu” instead of “Marketplace”.
Browse/home page hero/banner image alt text and the main page heading/subheading reflect the “Meyouu” brand name.

No remaining user-facing occurrences of the old app name “Marketplace” used as the product/brand name (excluding generic uses of the word marketplace in descriptive sentences, if any are intentionally kept).

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
nonGoals: Do not change backend canister logic or data models.
Do not redesign the UI theme or layout beyond updating the app name text.
